steps.action: Rocket.Chat web (open.rocket.chat/channel/sandbox) on Windows, emoji picker open in the composer
hovering emojis, the white name tooltip shows next to the hovered emoji (:grinning:, :upside_down:, :melting_face:, :kissing_heart:, :zany_face: ...)
switches to the hand-gestures section, :palm_down_hand: tooltip next to the emoji
clicks the Notepad icon in the taskbar, Notepad opens on top of the right half of the page
moves the pointer back over the picker without clicking the browser
hovering :eye_in_speech_bubble:, its white tooltip appears at the page top-left corner (over the 'Enter your E2E password' banner), only a small native title tooltip is next to the emoji
hovering :speech_left:, tooltip again at the page top-left corner
hovering :zzz:, tooltip shows next to the emoji
recording ends with Notepad still open

actual: Before focusing another app the tooltips sit next to hovered emojis. After clicking Notepad and returning the pointer without clicking, tooltips for some emojis render at the page's top-left corner, from about 00:27 to 00:31.
decisive: 00:27.25-00:30.6 ':eye_in_speech_bubble:' tooltip at the page top-left corner while the pointer is on that emoji in the picker; 00:30.88 same for ':speech_left:'.
not_visible: whether the browser window lost focus is only inferred from Notepad being opened and on top
which tooltips are misplaced vs correct follows no visible rule (:zzz: at 00:37.2 is placed correctly)
notes: At 00:25.5 and 00:26.8 :white_heart: and :speech_balloon: tooltips appear at the left edge of the picker, not next to the emoji; also a misplacement but not the top-left corner. At 00:01.8 one tooltip also briefly appears left of the picker before Notepad, unconfirmed at this zoom.
